normalization.1nf: Every relation has atomic, non-decomposable columns. Coordinates (plot_x, plot_y), timestamps, currency amounts, and separate user profile fields contain single values without repeating groups or multi-valued attributes.
normalization.2nf: All non-key attributes are fully functionally dependent on the entire primary key (surrogate ID). There are no partial dependencies on composite keys across all 26 entities.
normalization.3nf: All transitive dependencies are eliminated. Payment terms, service definitions, section coordinates, reminders, transfer audits, and booking schedules are isolated into dedicated normalized relational tables.
